profile.headline: iOS Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Hi! I am an engineer who’s passionate about making human-centric software. 

Presently, I am an iOS engineer at Veeva Systems where my team is digitizing eConsent and eCOA to make it easier and faster for patients to participate in clinical trials. I joined while our app was still in a greenfield space and I’ve enjoyed working on an early product while also bringing it to maturity and crafting an exceptional experience in a mission critical app.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description: I am working as an iOS engineer for MyVeeva for Patients, a greenfield app that’s modernizing the clinical trial space by letting patients participate all through their personal device. I collaborate directly with product managers and designers to translate requirements and designs into native UI, ensure feature parity across mobile by working with Android, and ensure our app is robust by syncing with QA. I lead projects end-to-end to create user-facing experiences using core iOS technologies like UIKit, SwiftUI, Combine, and Swift Concurrency.

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description: I studied the viability of television white space networks for providing internet access in rural areas with a focus on improving emergency preparedness and response. I had the opportunity to apply our research by distributing an Android app aiding first responders and community members in Warren County, NY.
positions.insights: Skills: Communication · Software Engineering · Android Development · Python (Programming Language) · Data Analysis
